book.name: Matiu
book.title: Matiu Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Matiu girumalena

content: Iesu inainamba leusan
Ema aupe walama 6 diantono Iesu me wawe alala bedeuwo Pita, Iems ita me wamba Ion otamone muba os wadi debama iwe banlamone odane anton.
Sape wimone tauma Iesu mo danauwo inainamba leulene da segalen ita me namba sapa wan omo sapawa rua. Ita me garawa do kibokiboralene sapaida wan.
Tauma wawe alala natadea sape eneio Moses Elaia nata segantone Iesu do gagalontoio ewamoiena.
Ita Pita Iesu diene wanase, “Tatamba, ide dewantene bola ema euda bedewe winen. E meneempa ne ape natadea wadamopa, dea e baia, dea Moses baiwa ita da Elaia baiwa.”
Pita gagaloleidioma giou sapusapua aisidene nosene mo taubodamono ita giou bedewe aia segalene wanase, “Ema ipa ne nuawadawadana Otopaida, nuana eusadio wainedina. Me aiawa etanadewaitana!”
Wawe alala aia ema etane saidantone mo imimpu emmisintone dunenton.
Tane Iesu mo mampo wisene ibubu wadene diamone wanase, “Enana, mai saitana!”
Mo enane pisiwane tane Iesu meba enedio eweiena, mai mida da, dia.
Tauma mo wadi iwe leuntone ieie into Iesu diamone wanase, “Dima e ewalana mai apana da benemamono etapu, dia. Tane Apana Otopa bo bedewe enepiwisepio tauma benemaitano apana atentopu.”
Sape wawe alala Iesu waitarasane waienase, “Dima baiwa anaana waeuwalala waie waiase, ‘Peroweta Elaia bauta wisepio wawe Keriso mida God saualena wisepi?’”
Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Elaia ideita bauta wisepi ita nitu uduudu aupo teadewasamopie imaamopi.
Ne dialedina Elaia aitamana wisen, tane mo me mai atensapona, tane mo insaisau rua dewasane me bosaiena. Deawaa Apana Otopa pokaida etepi mo mampo.”
Wawe alala aia ema etane atentoiena dima Iesu Elaia umanawa wana, sa ipa me Ion Babatutu umanawa wadie.
Iesu oto sanaa inasade
Mo wadiwae leuntone iane apana uara mampo nomono apana dea Iesu mampelene imimpa emmisilene
wane wanase, “Tatamba, ne otona nuaparewaitaa, me walamawa wisedio uwawa koakoaleide ita poka debama etede. Me guriboboleidie ia iilala ita esa bedewe omedie aleide.
Ne me banlene e waawo alala mampo winene iririmona inasapona baiwa, tane mo rubusanalewanton.”

Iesu leusane wanase, “Walama ande apanawa ambi e sumanaisiawaiaida, insaisala do kiokiowa! Mapo os e ne do wankasantene dialedino os wainilee, tane mai sumanaitapona, dia! E baila ne poka etaidasadina. E aitane oto sa banlene mainawo winlena!”
Mo oto kerola banlene wimono Iesu aiawa badowa mampe aleu kadiwa taneno nosene alen ita oto tauwadea os inalen.
Ema aupe wawe alala Iesu mampe wimone werego waitarasane waienase, “Dima baiwa no aleu kadiwa mai tanapona rua?”

Me sipoamone wanase, “E sumanaila kerauda baiwa mai tanana rua, dia. Ne ulaipa dialedina sumanai mampe dewa uduudu e dewasana rua. Naita e sumanaila paipai naumba kerauda rua manlawo winompa e rua os wadi ema diane wanase, ‘Riaite sisi aitaa,’ ruawa me rialepi.”
Iesu osowe bowa gagalowa wade
Iesu wawe alala do Galili bedewe auweieno tauma Iesu mo diamone wanase, “Apana Otopa mo laga mampe nanantopue apana witaposapuo
bosapu. Tane walama natadeawo me bo bedewe enepiwisepi.” Me wawe alala aia ema etane nuau pareidalen.
God duwa manewa waitarawa
Iesu wawe alala do Kapeanaum bedewe wimoio God duwa manewa tamalala dea Pita mampe wisene waitarasane wanase, “E debamala God duwa manewa itude, ba dia?”

Pita me sipoasane wanase, “Oa, me mane itude.” Pita du bedewe odeno Iesu Pita waitarasane wanase, “Saimon, e ambi inseiana? Tawo warereu apana dainea mampo mane wadei? Mo muba apanau mampo ba bola da apanawa mampo?”
Pita leusane wanase, “Bola da apanawa mampo, mai muba apanau.” Iesu me sipoasane wanase, “E waadewaiten, warere bolawa apanawa mai mane itupu, dia.

Tane no mai menaneipona God duwa manewa tamalala apanawa nuawa kadisata. Sa baiwa doa tampe aitee kaimoitaa, ita bouri bauta teinea moawa wadaake bedewe mane nepa dea donsaa. Mane nepa sa rualepio God duwa manewa tamalala wanamoa e ne nata baimba.”
